lines.en: Step by step, my feet find the grey stone.

lines.zh: 庭院七丈，我走了四十年。
lines.en: Seven yards of courtyard, walked for forty years.
Mind the moss in the paving cracks.

lines.zh: 走过廊柱，影子扫过壁画。
lines.en: Past the pillars, my shadow sweeps the murals.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，是不想踩碎什么。
lines.en: I walk slowly so as not to break anything.

lines.zh: 石阶有二十七级，我数过。
lines.en: Twenty-seven steps; I have counted them.
Each footfall must land exactly true.
Wind through the cloister lifts the stone dust.

lines.zh: 脚尖先落地，脚跟再跟上。
lines.en: Toes first, then the heel follows.

lines.zh: 从祭坛走到院门，正好百步。
lines.en: Altar to gate: exactly one hundred paces.

lines.zh: 走完这一圈，再走下一圈。
lines.en: Finish this round, then begin the next.
One tile is loose; I step around it.
Sitting still, I listen to my own breath.

lines.zh: 掌心的老茧，是石头磨出来的。
lines.en: The callus on my palms was worn there by stone.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我肩上，我不拂。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shoulder; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 院子里的风铃，多久没响了。
lines.en: How long since the courtyard chime last rang?

lines.zh: 地上有一道裂纹，我看了很久。
lines.en: There is a crack in the floor; I study it.
The earth's veins flow slowly under my feet.

lines.zh: 我把手指按进土里，试一试。
lines.en: I press my fingers into the soil and test it.

lines.zh: 又一个来访者，脚步声太急。
lines.en: Another visitor, with footsteps far too hurried.

lines.zh: 闭眼时，能听见石头说话。
lines.en: With eyes closed, I hear the stone speak.
I have worn these gauntlets far too long.
Ash covers the altar; it needs sweeping.
I count the drips from the eaves.
When I go still, the ground stops shaking.

lines.zh: 这院里没有第二个人的气息。
lines.en: No other breath in this courtyard but mine.

lines.zh: 我把拳套放在膝上，慢慢擦。
lines.en: I set the gauntlet on my knee and wipe it slow.

lines.zh: 石阶上又多了几个脚印，不深。
lines.en: A few more prints on the steps, not deep.
The soles of your boots are worn thin.
Have you come for the trial, or to die?
Your stance puts the weight on your right foot.

lines.zh: 手里那件兵器，不适合跳。
lines.en: That weapon will not help you jump.

lines.zh: 我看着你，也在看你的影子。
lines.en: I watch you, and I watch your shadow too.

lines.zh: 上一个来访者，没走到第三层。
lines.en: The last visitor never reached the third tier.

lines.zh: 你眼里有火，可惜不够静。
lines.en: There is fire in your eyes, but no stillness.
Do not speak yet; stand here a while.
You breathe too shallow; standing practice will make you faint.
This courtyard knows people, not swords.

lines.zh: 你想学地卜术？先学会摔。
lines.en: Geomancy? Learn to fall first.

lines.zh: 我认得出哪种步子能登顶。
lines.en: I can tell which gait could reach the top.

lines.zh: 你的骨头还年轻，别浪费。
lines.en: Your bones are still young; do not waste them.
Lift your head and look into my eyes.

lines.zh: 这一下，震得我手腕发麻。
lines.en: That blow numbed my wrist.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是让，不是败。
lines.en: I gave half a step; that is courtesy, not defeat.
Even a hard fist can ache.

lines.zh: 别打旧伤，那里骨头接歪了。
lines.en: Not the old wound; the bone healed crooked.
Blood seeps between my fingers.
I grit my teeth and sink my breath.
This move, I will remember.
You are faster than I expected.
Hold still; let me catch my breath.
Pain can be endured; breath must not scatter.

lines.zh: 一块好青石，我会多看一眼。
lines.en: A fine slab of stone will earn a second look.

lines.zh: 若你说能登顶，我会心动。
lines.en: If you claim you can reach the top, I listen.
Good tea, yes; anything else, no.
This courtyard lacks one good corner stone.

lines.zh: 有人肯认真学，我就肯教。
lines.en: Anyone who truly wants to learn, I will teach.

lines.zh: 你手里那枚古钱，纹路不错。
lines.en: That old coin in your hand has fine patterns.

lines.zh: 四十年了，还没人让我动心。
lines.en: Forty years, and no one has moved me yet.

lines.zh: 能让我起身的，只有对手。
lines.en: Only a worthy opponent makes me stand.

lines.zh: 别拿金子，那东西压不住地。
lines.en: Not gold; such things cannot hold the earth.
You say you have been here? I do not recall.
Bumping me is like hitting a wall.
Steady yourself before you hurt yourself.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我一步没动。
lines.en: You fell back two steps; I did not move.
The paving stones are softer than I am.
Step aside; you are blocking the center line.

lines.zh: 碰一下就晃，你脚步太虚。
lines.en: One nudge and you sway; your steps are hollow.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，早被石头磨过。
lines.en: These bones have been worn by stone already.
Do not push; I dislike being pushed.
Standing firm is also practice.

lines.zh: 两个人站得太近，谁都动不了。
lines.en: Standing this close, neither of us can move.

lines.zh: 这院里没有别人，也没有她。
lines.en: No one else in this courtyard, and not her.

lines.zh: 武僧的衣钵，断在我这里。
lines.en: The monk's lineage ends with me.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也想过收个徒弟。
lines.en: When young, I thought of taking a disciple.
Stones may pair; people cannot.

lines.zh: 她走后，我只剩下这套拳。
lines.en: After she left, only this fist art remained.

lines.zh: 没有后人，就把功夫刻在墙上。
lines.en: No heirs, so I carve my art into the walls.
At night I speak to the stone statues.
This road, I have walked alone to its end.

lines.zh: 传不下去的东西，才最重。
lines.en: What cannot be passed on is the heaviest.
I am not lonely; I am only quiet.
I do not pick up loose stones from the floor.
Keep this thing; it is yours.
My hands hold only fists, nothing else.
The fallen tile gets swept into the corner.
What is not mine, I do not take.
I lift a pinch of soil and return it.
This stone is flawed; put it back.
Set the thing down, and the person grows light.
I take no offerings, only challenges.
Easy to lift, hard to set down.

lines.zh: 你的脚步稳了，那就开始。
lines.en: Your steps have steadied; then we begin.
Your left foot floats, so your landing will drift.
Raise your hands; do not hide them.
This fight, I have waited a long time for.
The ground has begun to listen to me.
If you will not retreat, I will not hold back.
Its breath is disordered; now I may move.

lines.zh: 这一块砖以外，都算我的界。
lines.en: Beyond this one tile, all of it is my ground.
Step into the center court and you have accepted.

lines.zh: 我不先出手，但我会先到。
lines.en: I do not strike first, but I arrive first.
The stone in my gauntlet has woken.

lines.zh: 站定，别被自己的影子骗。
lines.en: Stand firm; do not be fooled by your own shadow.
The ground beneath will speak for me.
You come with intent, so I answer with mine.

lines.zh: 左三步，右一步，不用再数。
lines.en: Three left, one right; no need to count again.

lines.zh: 地上的纹路，替我算距离。
lines.en: The cracks in the floor measure the distance.

lines.zh: 你抬肩，我就知道你要出右拳。
lines.en: Your shoulder lifts; a right punch is coming.
I do not chase; I wait for you to come in.
The flagstones tremble very slightly.
I circle, hunting for its center of weight.
This feint is false, and so is the next.
The wind has stopped; now I hear footsteps.
It backs to the wall; its retreat is gone.
Gauntlet to the ground, borrowing a little earth.
At the count of three, I move.
You wait for me to move; so do I.

lines.zh: 脚跟一转，角度就全变了。
lines.en: A turn of the heel changes every angle.
This courtyard I know with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我不喊停，停不停由你的脚定。
lines.en: I do not call halt; your feet decide that.
One palm strike throws up stone chips.
My gauntlet strikes; flagstones heave upward.
My elbow drives into its chest plate.
I borrow the earth's force to strike you.
This kick sweeps at the knees.
The pillar blocks for me and strikes for me.
My fist is not fast, but it is heavy.

lines.zh: 地气顺着拳，一路推过去。
lines.en: Earth force runs down my arm into the blow.
It retreats; I advance half a step.
Retract, reset the stance, and again.

lines.zh: 天光落在院中，我站在那里。
lines.en: Daylight falls in the courtyard; I am standing there.

lines.zh: 石像后面，走出一个人影。
lines.en: From behind the statues steps a figure.
The incense died out long ago; I remain.
Dust sifts down from the rafters.

lines.zh: 我又一次扫净这片石地。
lines.en: Once more I sweep this stone floor clean.
The gate stands open, waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 山里的雾，一直漫到台阶。
lines.en: Mountain mist creeps all the way to the steps.

lines.zh: 拳套戴上，骨节响了一声。
lines.en: I put on the gauntlets; my knuckles crack.
Forty years, and the courtyard has not changed.
Perhaps today someone will reach the top.

lines.zh: 第一缕阳光照在地砖上。
lines.en: The first ray of sun touches the tiles.
I set the stele straight, then step back.

lines.zh: 呼吸沉下去，地脉就醒了。
lines.en: My breath sinks, and the earth veins wake.
Visitor, state your name.
Fire licks the stone wall; I do not retreat.

lines.zh: 从第三层摔下来，我摔过太多次。
lines.en: Falling from the third tier, as I have many times.
Water rises past my chest; my breath fails.
Flying stone from the blast is faster than a blade.
The arrow sticks in the wall, half an inch off.
A spell crawls along my bones.
Standing practice on an empty stomach makes the legs shake.
Lightning strikes the courtyard; every tile glows.
Nothing underfoot, and even the earth veins end.
